functions.description: Parse the ESXi kmxa syslog envelope and message category.
Extract the user associated with authentication, VM, and configuration activity.
Extract source addresses and destination ports from authentication and firewall events.
Extract datastore and remote storage endpoint details.
Extract VM names and migration destination hosts.

conf.regex: /(?:Migration of VM|Snapshot created for VM|Powered on VM|VM)\s+'(?<vm_name>[^']+)'(?:\s+to host\s+(?<dst_host>\S+))?/

functions.description: Normalize event action, application protocol, and traffic direction.

add.name: action
add.value: message.includes('authenticated successfully') ? 'login_success' : message.includes('logged in via') ? 'login_success' : message.includes('Repeated failed login attempts') ? 'account_lockout' : message.includes('Password change failed') ? 'password_change_failure' : message.includes('Migration of VM') ? 'migration_timeout' : message.includes('Failed to mount') ? 'mount_failure' : message.includes('link state changed') ? 'link_state_change' : message.includes('Snapshot created') ? 'snapshot_create' : message.includes('Blocked inbound connection') ? 'block' : message.includes('Successfully reconnected') ? 'reconnect' : message.includes('unreachable') ? 'connection_failure' : message.includes('Unrecoverable hardware error') ? 'hardware_failure' : message.includes('updated by user') ? 'update' : message.includes('usage exceeded') ? 'threshold_exceeded' : message.includes('Powered on VM') ? 'power_on' : undefined

add.name: protocol
add.value: message.includes('via SSH') ? 'ssh' : message.includes('via vSphere Client') ? 'vsphere' : message.includes('NFS datastore') ? 'nfs' : message.includes('iSCSI target') ? 'iscsi' : undefined

add.name: direction
add.value: category === 'Firewall' && message.includes('inbound connection') ? 'inbound' : category === 'Auth' && src_ip ? 'inbound' : category === 'Storage' && dst_ip ? 'outbound' : undefined
